text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi company to start transporting passengers from Iraq to ports in the United Arab Emirates.
- President Saddam Hussein's envoys deliver letters to Algerian, Mauritanian leaders.
- Iraqi Trade Ministry offers for sale household electrical goods, car spare-parts and construction materials at prices slightly less than those of the commercial market.
- Iraq's Culture and Information Minister Hamed Youssef Hummadi opens in Algeria an exhibition of popular products.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Canada is willing to embark on oil projects in Iraq.
- A supertanker leaves Mina al-Bakr oil terminal after loading with two million barrels of Iraqi oil.
- Kuwaiti crown prince and prime minister Saad al-Abdullah al-Subah admitted to hospital in Britain.
- Chinese Communist party delegation holds talks with officials of Iraq's ruling Baath party.
